title: Gamblemon - Generations-Core
description: Gamble a ditto into a random pokemon from Cobblemon. Works with fakemons. Requires Generations-Core.
body:
Extremely simple lightweight datapack.

Gamble a Time Capsuled Ditto into any random level 15 pokemon by dropping it.

Requires [Generations-Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/generations-core)
